## Projects
- Homesty.ai — buyer-side real-estate chat: a buyer asks about a property and gets answers from real listings. Landing, chat, REST, admin, auth, audit log. https://homesty.ai
- Anvil — webhook receiver that dedupes re-deliveries in Redis and hands jobs to a BullMQ worker, with retry and dead-letter. TypeScript, Express, Docker. npm @ykstormsorg/anvil. https://github.com/ykstorm/anvil
- Anchor — pgvector RAG that returns no answer when the best match is too weak. Next.js, Postgres, Prisma, Vercel. https://github.com/ykstorm/anchor
- Tripwire — checks LLM output mid-stream and stops it when a rule trips. Ships an Express proxy. npm @ykstormsorg/tripwire. https://github.com/ykstorm/tripwire
- Stackup — one-command local Kubernetes cluster with canary deploys and auto-rollback. Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Prometheus, Grafana. https://github.com/ykstorm/stackup
- Goldset — eval runner as a GitHub Action that gates merges on regression. npm @ykstormsorg/goldset. https://github.com/ykstorm/goldset
- Quickdraw — CLI that benchmarks LLM streaming. npm @ykstormsorg/quickdraw. https://github.com/ykstorm/quickdraw
- Codecraft — in-browser IDE that boots a dev server in the tab via WebContainers. https://codecraft-ai-tau.vercel.app
